title: Creeper
statementMd:
Implement a unitary operation on 3 qubits which is represented by a square matrix of size 8 with the following pattern:

```
XX....XX
XX....XX
...XX...
...XX...
..X..X..
..X..X..
XX....XX
XX....XX
```

Here `X` denotes a "non-zero" element of the matrix (a complex number which has the square of the absolute value greater than or equal to $10^{-5}$), and `.` denotes a "zero" element of the matrix (a complex number which has the square of the absolute value less than $10^{-5}$).

The row and column indices of the matrix follow little endian format: the least significant bit of the index is stored first in the qubit array. Thus, the first column of the matrix gives you the coefficients of the basis states you'll get if you apply the unitary to the $|00..0\rangle$ basis state, the second column - to the $|10..0\rangle$ basis state etc. You can use the [DumpUnitary tool](https://github.com/Microsoft/QuantumKatas/tree/master/utilities/DumpUnitary) to get the coefficients of the matrix your unitary implements (up to relative phases between columns) and the corresponding pattern of `X`s and `.`s.

You have to implement an operation which takes an array of 3 qubits as an input and applies the unitary transformation with the matrix of the described shape to it. If there are multiple unitaries which satisfy the requirements, you can implement any of them. The "output" of your operation is the pattern of the matrix coefficients implemented by it; you can see the testing harness in the [UnitaryPatterns](https://github.com/Microsoft/QuantumKatas/tree/master/UnitaryPatterns) kata.

Your code should have the following signature:

```
namespace Solution {
    open Microsoft.Quantum.Primitive;
    open Microsoft.Quantum.Canon;

    operation Solve (qs : Qubit[]) : Unit {
        // your code here
    }
}
```

You are not allowed to use measurements in your operation.
statementZhMd:
实现一个作用于 3 个量子比特的酉操作。该操作由一个大小为 8 的方阵表示，其具有如下模式：

```
XX....XX
XX....XX
...XX...
...XX...
..X..X..
..X..X..
XX....XX
XX....XX
```

这里，`X` 表示矩阵中的“非零”元素（绝对值的平方大于或等于 $10^{-5}$ 的复数），`.` 表示矩阵中的“零”元素（绝对值的平方小于 $10^{-5}$ 的复数）。

矩阵的行索引和列索引采用小端格式：索引的最低有效位存储在量子比特数组的第一个量子比特中。因此，矩阵的第一列给出了将该酉操作应用于 $|00..0\rangle$ 基态后得到的各个基态的系数，第二列给出了将其应用于 $|10..0\rangle$ 基态后的系数，以此类推。你可以使用 [DumpUnitary 工具](https://github.com/Microsoft/QuantumKatas/tree/master/utilities/DumpUnitary)来获取你的酉操作所实现的矩阵的系数（列之间的相对相位除外），以及对应的 `X` 和 `.` 的模式。

你需要实现一个操作，以 3 个量子比特组成的数组作为输入，并对其应用具有上述形状矩阵的酉变换。如果有多个酉操作满足要求，你可以实现其中任意一个。你的操作的“输出”是它所实现的矩阵系数的模式；你可以在 [UnitaryPatterns](https://github.com/Microsoft/QuantumKatas/tree/master/UnitaryPatterns) 题库中查看测试程序。

你的代码应具有以下签名：

```
namespace Solution {
    open Microsoft.Quantum.Primitive;
    open Microsoft.Quantum.Canon;

    operation Solve (qs : Qubit[]) : Unit {
        // your code here
    }
}
```

不允许在你的操作中使用测量。
